summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Fury Gold Mines Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, attaching a press release dated May 19, 2026. The press release announces the commencement of additional metallurgical testwork at the company's 100% held Eau Claire Gold Project in Quebec, Canada. The testwork program, conducted by SGS Canada Inc., aims to support feasibility and development planning, including optimizing ore processing, tailings management, and environmental compliance. It is a routine operational update regarding project advancement, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, as no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation transaction is involved.
